item.title: When RStudio asks if you want to save your workspace… but you KNOW its going to make your life miserable.
item.description: Every time RStudio pops up with that “Do you want to save your workspace?” prompt, I feel like I’m being asked if I want to make my day 20% more difficult. “Sure, save it - let's see which obscure error shows up next time.” It's like playing roulette, but with your sanity. Who’s with me? 😂
